title: Align advertised external providers with runtime auth registration
description:
Problem: MemorySmith currently advertises GitHub, Google, and Microsoft as configurable external sign-in providers across admin/profile surfaces and docs, but the startup auth pipeline only registers a GitHub OAuth handler. In `MemorySmith.App/Program.cs`, startup adds `auth.AddOAuth("GitHub", ...)` with `/signin-github`, but no corresponding `AddGoogle`, `AddMicrosoftAccount`, or custom OAuth registrations were found for the other providers. At the same time, `Admin.razor`, `Profile.razor`, `SecurityServices.cs`, and `Data/Pages/guides/configuration-reference.md` all treat Google and Microsoft as configurable/provider-usable when enabled and given client IDs. This creates a misleading operator contract: admins can configure providers that the runtime does not actually activate.

Evidence from 2026-05-26 audit:
- `MemorySmith.App/Program.cs` registers only GitHub external auth.
- `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Admin.razor` shows Google and Microsoft as configurable provider rows with setup links and configured-state checks.
- `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Profile.razor` treats Google and Microsoft links as usable sign-in methods when enabled and configured.
- `Data/Pages/guides/configuration-reference.md` currently groups `Providers:{GitHub|Google|Microsoft}:*` under the sign-in flow contract.

Desired outcome: provider-management UI, docs, and runtime auth registration should describe the same set of supported external sign-in providers.

Scope:
- In scope: either wire Google/Microsoft auth handlers with the expected callback routes and tests, or hide/mark those providers as unsupported placeholders in admin/profile/docs until runtime parity exists.
- In scope: provider availability messaging, callback-route documentation, and tests that assert the visible provider set matches the registered auth schemes.
- Out of scope: changing provider credential storage, first-admin bootstrap behavior, or broader auth UX beyond provider-support accuracy.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every provider shown as available/configurable for end-user sign-in has a matching runtime auth registration and callback path.
- Unsupported providers are not presented as usable sign-in options in `/profile`, `/login`, or provider docs.
- Focused tests cover provider availability against actual registered schemes or configuration gates.
- Docs and admin/provider surfaces no longer overstate supported providers.

Validation:
- Add focused auth/provider tests for visible provider availability and callback registration.
- Run the affected auth/admin test slice.
- Run `./Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1` after task creation/update.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created during 2026-05-26 audit after verifying that startup registers only GitHub OAuth while admin/profile/docs still advertise Google and Microsoft as usable external providers.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed by routing admin/profile/account-safety provider checks through the runtime authentication scheme registry. Focused tests passed for `ExternalAuthSupport_ReturnsOnlyRegisteredConfiguredProviders`, `RemoveLocalPasswordAsync_DoesNotTreatConfiguredButUnregisteredProviderAsFallback`, and the source-level auth-provider surface guard. Browser verification on isolated sandboxes confirmed `/admin` marks configured Google/Microsoft entries as `Unsupported`, `/profile` keeps usable sign-in methods at `1`, and `/login` still advertises only GitHub plus local password.
